description: The room holds a quiet warmth, smelling of dry cedar shavings and the fresh scent of rain on stone. A tall glass case stands against the wall, holding the great clock's brass gears like treasures kept safe from the storm. The ledger on the lectern lies open, its pages waiting for the next gentle hour to be written.
